results.notes: Wizard draft rebuilt as on 20/10: Unbranded analysis, topic 'Postal services', markets United Kingdom - English (GB (EN)) and France - French (FR (FR)); discovered categories C1 'Package Delivery' (FR 'Livraison de colis') and C2 'Mail Services' (FR 'Services de courrier') kept; Prompts step: 120 rows (40 Category Topics, 40 Visibility, 40 Competitive), pool block '1116 / 1000 prompts · 120 selected' (116 over - pool already at 996/1000, not blocking the table). Create Analysis never clicked. Badges: Visibility / Competitive / Category Topics only (PASS). Row type select (Edit prompt, then Escape leaves the row in edit mode with Category + Type comboboxes): generated Category Topics row 'What should I look for in Package Delivery?' -> 'Visibility, Category Topics, Competitive, Other'; generated Visibility row 'Best Package Delivery service?' -> same 4 options (PASS - GEO-1509 fixed for generated rows, 20/10 showed no Other). Closed with Escape, value unchanged. Add prompt draft row Type select: 'Visibility, Category Topics, Competitive, Other' (PASS). New row 'Which parcel lockers are easiest to use?' - Package Delivery - GB (EN), type left at default: badge 'Other', CUSTOM tag, banner '1 prompt is in Other.' (PASS). Side observation (not a CSV step, relevant to GEO-1509 'user-added prompts'): on that user-added row currently in Other, the edit-mode Type select lists only 'Visibility, Category Topics, Competitive' - 'Other' is shown as the trigger placeholder (data-placeholder) but is not an option (red frame in step3d_custom_other_row_bug.png). Selecting Other there would be a no-op, so the CSV step stays PASS; reported to the PO/dev as a residual inconsistency of GEO-1509.

results.notes: Data adaptation as on 20/10: analysis UA = QA-GEO unbranded "Electric bikes" 42c3ab89-7dfd-4ba5-b5ec-117cec2514e4 (1 market GB (EN), category "Commuter Electric Bikes" + automatic "Other", 31 prompt rows). Pool block before and after: "996 / 1000 prompts · 5 selected". Add prompt -> inline draft row (Category Other, Type Other, Market GB (EN)); Type select: "Visibility, Category Topics, Competitive, Other" (PASS); draft cancelled with Cancel (31 rows). Existing rows (Edit prompt, then Escape -> Category + Type comboboxes in the row): generated Visibility row "Best Commuter Electric Bikes?" -> "Visibility, Category Topics, Competitive, Other"; generated Category Topics row "What should I look for in Commuter Electric Bikes?" -> same 4 options (20/10: 3 options, no Other -> GEO-1509 fixed for generated rows). User-added row "Which electric bike brands are best for commuting in London?" (CUSTOM, Other / Other, Type combobox always shown with data-placeholder): options "Visibility, Category Topics, Competitive" - no Other option (red frame in step3_then). Every select closed with Escape, no value selected, nothing saved (network: GET only on /geo/api/). No Reputation or Brand Image in any select (PASS). PARTIAL rather than FAIL: on that row Other is the current (empty) type shown as placeholder, so picking Other would be a no-op; PO/dev to confirm whether Other must also be listed as an option there (GEO-1509 says generated AND user-added prompts).
results.observed_gap_before_decision: Step "And the user cancels and opens the type select of an existing row" - Expected: "The select lists Visibility, Competitive, Category Topics and Other only". Observed: generated rows now list "Visibility, Category Topics, Competitive, Other" (fixed since 20/10), but the user-added row "Which electric bike brands are best for commuting in London?" (CUSTOM, currently Other) still lists "Visibility, Category Topics, Competitive" only - "Other" appears only as the trigger placeholder, not as an option.
results.qa_decision: QA decision 2026-10-21 (user): dev answer on GEO-1509 (Abdenasser, comment 866019) accepted - on a prompt whose type is already Other, the select shows Other as its current value (46.7 AC5), so it lists only the types the prompt can move to; listing Other again would change nothing. Status set from PARTIAL to PASS; GEO-1509 moved to Passed QA.

results.notes: VERDICT GEO-1508: FIXED (not reproduced on Electric bikes / Postal services draft; the Game Developers analysis of the bug report was not used). 1) Dashboard, category "Commuter Electric Bikes" > Prompts Analysis table (Type is the first column, rows tr[data-testid^=dashboard-questions-row-]): 4 rows, 2 Category Topics. Side panel open (row "What makes Commuter Electric Bikes good quality?" expanded) and closed, at 1440x900 and 1280x800: badge 380->506 px (126 px, scrollWidth 126 = clientWidth 126) inside the type cell 368->544 (cell scrollWidth 176 = clientWidth 176); prompt cell starts at 544, prompt text at 556 -> gap 50 px, no overlap. With the side panel open the prompt column becomes narrow and the prompt wraps over several lines, but it never touches the badge. 2) Manage Scope > Prompts (Type column after Category): 10 Category Topics badges, all inside their cell (e.g. badge 1082->1192 in cell 1070->1200 at 1440; 922->1032 in cell 910->1040 at 1280), no overflow, min horizontal gap to visible prompt text 172 px at both widths. 3) Wizard Prompts step (Postal services draft, 120 rows, 40 Category Topics badges): all inside the type cell (e.g. 1095->1205 in 1083->1213 at 1440; 935->1045 in 923->1053 at 1280), no overflow; long French prompts are cut with an ellipsis (overflow hidden, nowrap) inside their own cell, visible text clipped before the badge - no overlap. No red frame needed (0 overlap). Measurement: badge pill rect vs the visible text rects of the prompt cell (clipped to overflow-hidden ancestors).
